title: PCSS Rule Registry Entry
description: A single rule in the PCSS rule registry. Each rule maps a statutory requirement to a PCSS capability. The registry as a whole is the cross-jurisdictional rulebook.

slug.description: Canonical slug for the rule. Used in Verdict reason codes.

capability.description: Which PCSS capability implements this rule.

applies_to_ages.description: Which Bearing age_bands trigger this rule.

default_outcome.description: Default outcome when rule is triggered. Most enforcement rules default to 'deny'.

enforcement_status.description: Whether the underlying statute is currently enforceable. Rules with status != 'in_force' should be advisory; conformance runners MUST surface non-in_force rules as informational and MUST NOT count them as required for badge eligibility unless explicitly opted in by the implementer.

advisory.description: If true, the rule produces guidance rather than enforcement. MUST be true for `proposed` status; SHOULD be true for `enjoined` or `phased` rules whose effective date is more than 90 days in the future.

applicable_from.description: ISO date when the underlying statute takes effect. Used for `in_force_phased` rules (e.g., CA AB 1043 effective 2027-01-01).

applicable_until.description: ISO date when the underlying statute ceased to apply (`repealed` or `superseded`).

superseded_by.description: If this rule has been superseded, slugs of replacement rules.

introduced_in.description: PCSS version in which this rule was introduced.

deprecated_in.description: PCSS version in which this rule was deprecated.
